dvdSpines: ImageGen original typographic interpretations; not scans. Cropped from four-strip sheet, rotated 90 degrees. No years.
gameSpines: ImageGen illustrated game spine atlas, cropped and uniformly resized with background padding to each case height/thickness ratio. Original interpretations, not retail scans.
gameIcons: ImageGen five-panel era-specific original art: GBA pixel platformer, PSP gritty ancient arena, iOS graph-paper doodle, 3DS low-poly adventure, Switch pastel island.
caseDimensions: Approximate proportional packaging dimensions, not calibrated product replicas.
albumSpines: Two ImageGen illustrated album spine atlases, cropped and uniformly resized with background padding. Original interpretations, not retail scans.
spineSizing: 96px wide WebP canvases. Game length follows case height/spine thickness; albums use 96:1600 ratio. Cropping and background padding preserve artwork proportions. See scripts/prepare-generated-spines.py.
